[imageid=9139466 medium rep]▪️ Red Leaf University is now available from Grail Games. From designers Adrian Adamescu (Sagrada) and Florin Purluca (Sparks). A very cute new worker-placement game with set collection and skills to increase. A game for 1-4 players and plays in 60-90 minutes.
From BGG:

Red Leaf delivers a streamlined euro-style experience: with your students, you’ll explore a university divided into six specialized campuses (Art, Business, Science, Architecture, etc.). Each campus allows players to recruit or upgrade a student of its discipline or engage in a unique minigame tied to its specialty.
The core gameplay revolves around sending one of your student tokens to an action space on the campus boards. Turns proceed clockwise until all students have been placed. Placing a student on an already occupied space costs more resources for each student already present. Students can be trained to Levels 1, 2, 3, or Master: higher levels unlock stronger actions and bonuses, and Master cards provide unique effects along with the ability to be placed on occupied spaces without paying.
The game takes place over five rounds, each introducing new opportunities and challenges. By optimizing the combos between your students’ effects, the benefits from each minigame (some using a tile-placement mechanism), and the various end-of-round and end-game objectives, you’ll score the most promotion points and become the valedictorian!

▪️ The Royal Society of Archeology is a new release Capstone Games and designer Eric Jumel. A new civilization game with worker-placement, set collection, end-game bonuses, player powers, and more. A bigger game for 1-4 players and plays in 90-120 minutes.
From BGG:

Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of early 20th-century explorers in The Royal Society of Archeology.
As the leader of a learned society, you lead a team of adventurers on expeditions around the globe in search of relics and knowledge. London serves as your headquarters, where you secure funding, deepen your expertise at the university, and plan your next bold discoveries.
Your archaeologists gain experience as the game progresses and become more and more efficient at performing actions. A unique mechanism allows you to trigger bonuses: If one of you places a less experienced archaeologist on an action space already occupied by a more experienced archaeologist, both people receive rewards. These strategic interactions add additional depth to your decisions.
During play, you will send your researchers to legendary archaeological sites, collect relics, gain prestige, and expand your scientific knowledge — but keep in mind that your success depends on the balance between your prestige points and scientific achievements

▪️ Wizerds, Warriors, and Werewolves is now available from Tycoon Games. From the teenage designer, Laurie Buchanan. Quick card game for the whole game of 2-8 players and plays in 20-30 minutes.
From BGG:

Welcome to the magical and dangerous realm of Entaria, where eight clans war over a dispute whose beginning is lost to time. You are a mighty champion setting out to defeat your enemies once and for all. As you arrive in the ancient forest, you realize that your enemies have settled on the same tactic- a battle to the end! But beware, as there are Werewolves and other beasts in these woods with threats of their own...
Wizerds, Warriors, & Werewolves is a fast-paced card-battling game for 2-8 players. Use your Champion’s special ability to gain an advantage. Die, and join the Ungrateful Dead, where you haunt other Champions. Survive, and become a legend in the realm of Entaria!

▪️ Peanuts Talent Show! is a new release from CMON Global Limited just in time for the holidays! From designers root (ルート) & Koudai Tateno. It is the age of trick-taking games, and here is one more to add to the collection. For 2-4 players and plays in 30 minutes.
From BGG:

In Peanuts Talent Show, 2–4 players compete in a fast and lively card game that combines trick-taking with light deck-building. Each round, you’ll lead your cast of performers like Snoopy, Charlie Brown, Woodstock, and more, into the spotlight. Win tricks to earn Coins, then use them to recruit new acts and expand your deck with bigger talents.
Peanuts Talent Show! plays in about 30 minutes, is easy to learn, and offers the perfect mix of familiar characters, light strategy, and playful competition.
